# telnyx_external_connection_phone_numbers (Data Source)

Lists external connection phone number settings, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_external_connection_phone_number_settings`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_connection_id` (String) The external connection id.

### Optional

- `filter_civic_address_id` (String) The civic address ID to filter by
- `filter_location_id` (String) The location ID to filter by
- `filter_phone_number` (String) The phone number to filter by (exact match)
- `filter_phone_number_contains` (String) The phone number to filter by (partial match)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `external_connection_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connection_phone_numbers))

<a id="nestedatt--external_connection_phone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connection_phone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `acquired_capabilities` (List of String)
- `civic_address_id` (String) Identifies the civic address assigned to the phone number.
- `displayed_country_code` (String) The iso country code that will be displayed to the user when they receive a call from this phone number.
- `location_id` (String) Identifies the location assigned to the phone number.
- `number_id` (String) Phone number ID from the Telnyx API.
- `telephone_number` (String) Phone number in E164 format.
- `ticket_id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
